Subject: Pilot Approval Request – Invoice Handling Assessment

Hi Morgan,

I'm writing to propose we move forward with our six-week pilot to assess invoice handling.

Here's what's on the table:

- Scope: Six-week pilot assessing invoice handling (production rollout excluded)
- Fee: $30,000 fixed
- Goal: 20% reduction in handling time

We know shorter handling times matter to your team. This pilot gives us a controlled, low-risk way to measure exactly what's possible—establishing the baseline we'll need to quantify savings going forward.

To proceed, I need your approval on two items:

1. Pilot scope and fee ($30,000)
2. Security clearance to begin (required before any client data access)

No start date is set yet, so once you approve, we'll coordinate timing with your security team.

Could you confirm approval by end of week? That keeps momentum on our side and lets us schedule resources accordingly.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you have questions.

Best,
Jordan
Engagement Lead
